claim: SWE-Router conditions routing on a partial agent trajectory read by a learned value head and proves this never harms routing relative to prompt-only routing.
stance_target: L3 routing-by-confidence has a close agentic occupant
quoted_support: We provide a Bayes-optimality theorem showing that conditioning on the partial trajectory never harms routing and is strictly better whenever exploration is informative.

breadth.confidence_families: learned value head P(eventual success) on partial trajectory (Sec 3, 5.2); no verbal, probe, or sampling-consistency confidence
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: gpt-5-mini, deepseek-v3.2 (weak); gemini-3-pro-preview (strong); Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct value head (Sec 5.2)
breadth.label_source: issue resolution via benchmark hidden tests
breadth.label_independence: train on SWE-Smith and SWE-Bench splits; validation SWE-Smith only (Sec 5.2)
breadth.calibration_metrics: Route-AUC, AUROC of value function (Sec 5.3); no ECE
breadth.causal_intervention: not present (searched: steering, ablation of probe)
